subject: Insurance
title: Ransom Insurance
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Ransom Insurance.

hook.text: Kidnap and ransom insurance quietly protects executives, journalists, and aid workers in dangerous regions worldwide.

buildup.text: K&R policies cover ransom payments, crisis consultants, hostage negotiators, and post-release psychological care.

discovery.text: Policyholders are forbidden from revealing they have K&R coverage. Knowing someone has it makes them a bigger target.

twist.text: Lloyd's of London is the dominant K&R market.

climax.text: K&R insurance is the most secretive product in the market. Its existence must be hidden to remain effective.

punchline.text: Coverage you can't mention. K&R insurance works only in secrecy.

quiz.question: Why must kidnap and ransom insurance be kept secret?
options: Revealing coverage makes the insured person a bigger kidnapping target
